about_the_game:
This game is a confinement suspense and love romance escape game in which the main character, who has lost her memory, aims to regain her memory and escape from the room in which she was confined.

The charm of this game

◆Memory loss

You are the main character with amnesia.

One of the goals of the game is to regain lost memories.

◆Easy gameplay

The game progresses by clicking on areas of interest in the room, examining them, and making choices.

Various events will occur depending on the choices you make, and in some events you will be able to acquire "memories".

◆Locked options

At the start of the game, some of your options are locked and will gradually be unlocked as you recover your memories.

Sometimes the key to success is to reach a bad ending and gain new "memories."

◆More than 10 multiple endings

This work has more than 10 endings, and depending on your choices, you can enjoy the many tragedies and happy endings that could exist.

◆3 unique characters

The man who imprisoned you, his twin brother, and the mysterious person who calls your name in your dreams...

Each one has a unique character.

◆Suspense and love romance

The appeal of this work is the story where sickness, darkness, and speculation intertwine.

Please clarify all the darkness.
